newsitem.title: USA: Public Storage XI agreed to merger.
newsitem.headline: Public Storage XI agreed to merger.

text.p: Public Storage Properties XI Inc said Monday it had agreed to merge with American Office Park Properties Inc, a unit of Public Storage Inc.
In the merger, Public Storage Properties will exchange 13 mini-warehouses for 11 commercial properties owned by Public Storage Inc.
After the merger, Public Storage Properties will own or operate 54 commercial properties in 11 states.
Combined, the companies would have generated net operating income of $13.4 million on revenue of $21.6 million for the six months ended June 30.
The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter.
